description: Will return list of linked companies (self included) and also the linked warehouses. Part of the Linked Sources APIs in Giddh. Requires Auth-Key or Session-Id.

q.description: Search text (case sensitivity depends on the endpoint). Optional.

count.description: Page size (number of items returned). Default: 0. Optional.

refresh.description: When true, bypass cache and recompute. Default: false. Optional.
